_comment: Nona's Dual-Race Training Configuration - March 30 to August 9, 2026
_races: Holcomb Valley 15mi Run (June 13) + Truckee Gravel 66mi Bike (June 27)
_nutrition_goal: 8-10 lbs fat loss while maintaining race performance

training_plan.goal_summary: Dual endurance races (15mi trail run + 66mi gravel bike) with body composition improvement

races.name: Holcomb Valley Trail Run
races.notes: Mountain trail race at 7000ft altitude. Focus: endurance + elevation

races.name: Truckee Gravel Gran Fondo
races.notes: Gravel cycling event, 40% dirt roads. Focus: endurance + power on varied terrain

phases.name: Kitchen Clean-Out / Transition
phases.notes: Use up whatever is in kitchen. No grocery shopping. Psychological preparation for strict phase starting April 4.

phases.name: Ultra-Constrained
phases.notes: Most restrictive phase. Establish baseline, reduce inflammation, identify food sensitivities.

phases.name: Constrained - First Expansion
phases.notes: Reintroduce Greek yogurt and additional vegetables. Monitor for sensitivities.

phases.name: Build - Expanded Diet
phases.notes: Gradual food reintroduction while training volume increases. Moderate deficit to fuel workouts.

phases.name: Taper & Race Fueling
phases.notes: Performance priority. Glycogen loading for races. Maintenance or slight surplus calories.

phases.name: Post-Race - Ultra-Constrained Adaptive
phases.notes: Return to ultra-constrained food list. Flexible based on new goals (new race, strength, maintenance).

fats: Minimal olive or avocado oil (cooking only, <1 tbsp/day)

still_forbidden: Most fruits (except maybe berries with yogurt)

performance.timing: Carb loading 2-3 days before races, simple carbs during long rides

ultra_constrained.breakfast: 3 scrambled eggs cooked in minimal olive oil + 1 medium sweet potato, baked (450 cal)
ultra_constrained.lunch: 6oz grilled chicken breast + 2 cups steamed carrots + 1 medium white potato, baked (550 cal)
ultra_constrained.dinner: 6oz baked white fish (cod) + 2 cups roasted carrots + 1 sweet potato (500 cal)

constrained_expanded.changes: Add 1 cup Greek yogurt to breakfast, replace carrots with mixed veggies (broccoli, spinach, peppers), add cucumber salad

expanded.approach: Macro targets - 30% protein, 45% carbs, 25% fat. ~2000 cal/day
expanded.examples: Protein: 150g (6oz chicken or 2 cups Greek yogurt), Carbs: 225g (1.5 cups rice or 2 cups oats), Fat: 56g (2oz almonds or 1 avocado)

am_workouts._note: Will be populated by extract_am_workouts.py from existing workbook

spine_exercises.exercises_placeholder: Cobra, Child's Pose, Cat-Cow, Knee-to-Chest with video links

long_run.progression: Increase 10% per week, max 13mi for 15mi race

tempo_run.pace: Comfortably hard (can speak in short phrases)

bike_endurance.notes: Cycling at similar effort as easy run. Longer duration, more miles due to speed difference.

bike_long.progression: Increase 10% per week, max 55mi for 66mi race
